thread:
Anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we found a gap in audit events for the token refresh endpoint between 03:20 and 03:40 UTC. Need owners, timeline, and action tracker.
Kevin: ack. do we have an example missing event id? can we correlate with load spikes?
Maria: i pulled logs, several refreshes completed but no corresponding audit record. sample query I ran:
```
SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE endpoint='/v1/token/refresh' AND ts >= '2026-03-15T03:15:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-15T03:45:00Z';
```
Result: 12 token refreshes w/o audit rows.
Rahul: likely related to batching flush logic in the audit writer. saw similar pattern last month when flush interval hit a race.
Anya: recurring pattern noted. let's create clear remediation: 1) own the code fix, 2) backfill audit rows or mark affected tokens, 3) add alert for audit drop below sampling threshold.
Kevin: i'll own 1) code fix. ETA 2026-03-22 EOD. I'll open PR and link here.
Kevin: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7423 — includes stronger flushing and metrics.
Maria: i'll own 2) backfill plan. estimate 2 days to run safe backfill + validation. will coordinate with infra maintenance window.
Rahul: i'll own 3) alerting and add additional sampling checks. setting sampling verify job to run every 15m and alert if audited_count < 0.95 * expected.
Anya: assigned owners and timelines. create single tracker issue and add to the postmortem checklist.
Maria: tracker created: https://issues.redwood.ai/SEC-4071 — includes subtasks for detection query, backfill, and verification.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new alert rule created in PagerDuty: AuditEventDrop - severity: high; threshold: audited_rate < 95% for 3 consecutive periods.
Kevin: small note — secrets rotation work intersecting with token refresh flow. we should ensure rotation won't be skipped during backfill; tagging SEC-4071 with secrets-rotation-prod.
Anya: reminder: add runbook steps to handle incomplete audit rows and how to mark them as 'investigated' in the console.
Rahul: adding a scheduled weekly sampling dashboard to the Console. planning doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/audit-sampling
Maria: will coordinate backfill window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. posting calendar invite.
Kevin: after PR merges, will push canary and run integration test that asserts audit_event_cnt increments on refresh.
Anya: thanks — one more: add follow-up check in 2 weeks to confirm no regressions. @Kevin @Maria @Rahul please ack when you have updates.
Kevin: ack — will post status in SEC-4071.
Maria: ack.
Rahul: ack.
Anya: closing thread for now, leaving issue open for tracking — will ping on the follow-up check.
